snippet.title: Normal Fishing Teaser - The Bworg (Pocketpair Publishing)
snippet.description:
🖤Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611240/Normal_Fishing/

Pocketpair Publishing announces its fourth game, "Normal Fishing"! A retro-inspired adventure game where mystery and horrors lurk behind a fishing facade!

▼Game Overview
Title: Normal Fishing
Genre: Adventure
Release Date: TBA
Supported Platform: PC (Steam)
Official Website: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611240/Normal_Fishing/
Developer: The Bworg
Publisher: Pocketpair Publishing

●Pocketpair Publishing

Pocketpair Publishing provides comprehensive support for indie game developers and small studios through funding, development assistance, and publishing.

For inquiries or questions, please contact Pocketpair Publishing via the Pocketpair Publishing inquiry form on the official Pocketpair website.
